definition:
### Complexity analysis

The reconciliation loop terminates in $O(n \log n)$ comparisons where $n$ is the
number of tracked replicas.  Because each retry sleeps for $0.25 \cdot k$ seconds
on attempt $k$, the worst case wall clock cost is $\sum_{k=1}^{10} 0.25k = 13.75$
seconds.

If the convergence probability per attempt is $p = 0.4$, the expected attempt
count is $1/p = 2.5$, so typical latency remains near $\tfrac{3}{4}$ of a second.
